co_created_baseline.real_scenario: Pressure-test skill-refiner on github-repo-radar to prove external best-practice research depth before any production Skill change.
co_created_baseline.business_constraint: Shadow run only: no shared/skills/github-repo-radar production file modification.
co_created_baseline.success_standard: Every SR-R ring records official, GitHub, and community source classes; result and ledger validate; run-all lists the dedicated gate.
co_created_baseline.known_pain: Earlier co-creation could stay shallow or only research Flow, leaving other rings supported by local context only.
co_created_baseline.non_loss_capability: Keep github-repo-radar seven-layer evaluation, red lines, action states, and no-single-signal verdicts.
co_created_baseline.entry_point: Eval and Resource, because the missing behavior is a verifiable source-depth contract and source audit artifact.
co_created_baseline.open_questions: No production modification decision is made in this shadow run; SR-F1 freezes only the shadow evidence package.

professional_domain.name: GitHub repository discovery and evaluation
responsibilities: Discover GitHub repositories with current GitHub or authoritative upstream evidence
Evaluate purpose fit, license, maintenance, security, adoption, contribution path, and exit path
Convert evidence into action states: discard, watch, trial, deep-read, contribute, or adopt
non_goals: Use stars, Trending, README, downloads, or Scorecard totals as single-point verdicts
Modify github-repo-radar production Skill during this shadow run
Recommend repositories without live or authoritative evidence
professional_domain.success_boundary: A refinement run can prove all-ring external source depth without changing the target Skill.

practice_flow: SR-S1 locates github-repo-radar and reads Skill quality standard.
SR-S2 frames a shadow-only pressure test focused on external best-practice depth.
SR-S3 defines the professional domain as GitHub repository discovery and evaluation.
SR-S4 inventories local consumers: SKILL.md, evaluation rubric, dogfood result, ledger, source audit, and test gate.
SR-R1 through SR-R10 each consume official GitHub docs, GitHub-hosted source evidence, community/industry health metrics, local rubric, and user context.
SR-F1 freezes final_operation=optimize for shadow evidence only.
SR-E1 writes dogfood artifacts and test registration, not production github-repo-radar files.
SR-V1 validates result, ledger, source audit, and related skill-refiner regression tests.

optimization_goal.objective: Prove skill-refiner can force deep, all-ring external best-practice research for a real GitHub repository evaluation Skill.
success_standards: All ten ring_blueprints include official, GitHub, and community source evidence.
Ledger ring_sources mirror the same external source classes.
Source audit records concrete URLs and how each source class is used.
Dedicated test and validator pass without production target modifications.
exclusions: No production github-repo-radar rewrite or patch.
No claim that the target Skill is now fully optimized.
No live repository recommendation for an end user.
